author: Krono III
title: Arch Ablation 2: No Attention Pooling
abstract: This is the second experiment in my architectural ablation study. I am testing the contribution of the attention pooling mechanism by replacing it with a simple flatten operation. I hypothesize this will significantly decrease performance. The baseline is the DoubleStepSynergyNet with the validated optimal mistake_penalty of 1.0.
